description: This PHP class 'I18NMessagesController' handles internationalization message requests. It processes HTTP requests for localization data, returning JSON translations based on the locale parameter, and manages HTTP caching headers.

classes.name: I18NMessagesController
classes.description: Handles internationalization message requests, serving JSON translation data and setting appropriate HTTP headers.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Returns the I18NService instance from the service container.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request, manages locale selection, ETag caching, and returns the translation messages as JSON.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets common HTTP headers on the response, including Content-Type, Cache-Control, and Pragma.
